title: The Ball
description:
Deal 10 damage.
Increase this card's damage by 15 this combat and give it to a random ally.
upgraded_description:
Deal 10 damage.
Increase this card's damage by 25 this combat and give it to a random ally.
notes: Multiplayer only. After being played as the last card in a series, this card is given to a random alive ally player. If discarded normally, it goes to the Draw pile instead.
